cases.expected: JsonSchema instance returned; default URI translator used; cache miss path exercised; JSON parser invoked
cases.description: When config is null the factory must fall back to its own URI translator. The schema is a regular JSON file, cache is disabled, and id does not match the source URI, so the else‑branch of idMatchesSourceUri is taken.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance returned; config.getUriTranslator() combined with factory translator; cache miss path exercised; JSON parser invoked
cases.description: When a non‑null config is supplied the method must combine the config‑provided URI translator with the factory‑provided one.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException thrown (cause IllegalArgumentException)
cases.description: The uriFactory.create call throws IllegalArgumentException for a malformed URI; the method must log the error and wrap it in JsonSchemaException.

cases.expected: Previously cached JsonSchema instance returned; its ValidationContext config replaced with supplied config
cases.description: When caching is enabled and the mapped URI is already present in uriSchemaCache, the method must return the cached JsonSchema and update its ValidationContext with the new config.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance returned; yamlMapper.readTree used; idMatchesSourceUri evaluated (any result) but not relevant for branch coverage
cases.description: When the URI ends with a .yaml/.yml extension, isYaml() returns true, causing the method to parse the InputStream with yamlMapper instead of jsonMapper.

group: Cache Miss – JSON schema with id matching source URI

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance returned; idMatchesSourceUri true; ValidationContext created with jsonMetaSchema and config; doCreate called with suppressSubSchemaRetrieval = true
cases.description: When the schema’s $id (or id) exactly matches the source URI, the method follows the true‑branch of idMatchesSourceUri, creating a ValidationContext that includes the meta‑schema and passes ‘true’ to suppress sub‑schema retrieval.

group: Cache Miss – JSON schema with id NOT matching source URI

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance returned; idMatchesSourceUri false; ValidationContext created via createValidationContext(schemaNode); doCreate called with suppressSubSchemaRetrieval = false
cases.description: When the schema’s $id does not match the source URI, the else‑branch is taken, a ValidationContext is built from the schema node, config is set afterwards, and doCreate is invoked with ‘false’.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException thrown (cause IOException)
cases.description: If uriFetcher.fetch throws or the InputStream cannot be read (e.g., network error), the method must catch IOException, log it and re‑throw as JsonSchemaException.

cases.expected: InputStream.close() invoked exactly once after successful schema load
cases.description: Regardless of success or failure, the finally block must close the InputStream if it was opened.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance returned; schema is stored in uriSchemaCache because enableUriSchemaCache=true and cache was previously empty for this URI
cases.description: When caching is turned on but the requested URI is not yet cached, the method must fetch, parse and then put the newly created JsonSchema into the cache.

group: Cache Hit after Miss with Caching Enabled

cases.expected: Previously cached JsonSchema instance returned; its ValidationContext config replaced with secondConfig
cases.description: After the first call cached the schema (see previous test), a second call with a different config must hit the cache, return the same JsonSchema object and update its ValidationContext with the new config.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance returned; the URI passed to uriFactory.create is the result of config.getUriTranslator().with(factoryTranslator).translate(originalUri) (e.g., http://example.com/base/translated/schema.json)
cases.description: When a config provides its own URITranslator that rewrites the incoming URI (e.g., adds a path segment), the method must use the combined translator, and the mapped URI used for fetching and caching must reflect the translation.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance returned; factory's default URI translator is used because config.getUriTranslator() is null; no NullPointerException is thrown
cases.description: The method calls config.getUriTranslator().with(factoryTranslator). If the config's translator is null, the implementation should fall back to the factory translator without throwing NPE. The test verifies graceful handling.

group: Parsing Error due to Wrong Content Type (YAML in JSON file)

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException thrown (cause JsonProcessingException) because jsonMapper fails to parse YAML content from a .json file
cases.description: The URI ends with .json, so isYaml() returns false and jsonMapper is used. The underlying stream actually contains YAML, causing a parsing failure that must be wrapped in JsonSchemaException.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException thrown (cause IllegalArgumentException or NullPointerException) because uriFactory.create cannot handle a null URI
cases.description: Passing a null schemaUri should result in an exception wrapped as JsonSchemaException; the test confirms that the method does not silently succeed.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException thrown (cause NullPointerException) when attempting to read from a null InputStream
cases.description: If the URISchemeFetcher returns null instead of a valid InputStream, the subsequent readTree call will throw NPE; the method must wrap it in JsonSchemaException.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException thrown (cause IOException from InputStream.close())
cases.description: The uriFetcher returns a valid InputStream, but its close() method throws an IOException. The finally block attempts to close the stream, the IOException is caught by the outer catch block and wrapped in JsonSchemaException.

cases.expected: NullPointerException (or RuntimeException) thrown and not wrapped in JsonSchemaException
cases.description: The config provides a URITranslator whose with() method (or translate()) throws a NullPointerException/RuntimeException. The method calls config.getUriTranslator().with(factoryTranslator) before any try‑catch for this specific exception, so the exception propagates out of getSchema.

cases.expected: IllegalStateException (or other RuntimeException) thrown and not wrapped in JsonSchemaException
cases.description: The URISchemeFetcher.fetch(mappedUri) throws a RuntimeException (e.g., IllegalStateException). Since the method only catches IOException, the RuntimeException propagates unchanged.

group: MetaSchema not found leading to NullPointerException

cases.expected: NullPointerException thrown (cause findMetaSchemaForSchema returned null and idMatchesSourceUri dereferences it)
cases.description: The schema content is such that findMetaSchemaForSchema returns null. The subsequent call to idMatchesSourceUri(metaSchema, ...) dereferences the null metaSchema, causing a NullPointerException which is not caught by the method.

cases.expected: IllegalStateException thrown (or other RuntimeException) and not wrapped in JsonSchemaException
cases.description: When idMatchesSourceUri returns false, the method calls createValidationContext(schemaNode). If this method throws a RuntimeException, the exception propagates out of getSchema because only IOException is caught.
